items.title: How much does waiting to catch a gap actually cost?
items.description: Sam's bulk-actions gap (from L2/L3) could have been caught in the same conversation, or two weeks later after shipping. Drag "Days until the gap is discovered" from 0 (resolved in the clarifying conversation itself) out toward 60 (found long after ship) and watch the relative cost multiplier climb — not in a straight line, but compounding, the same claim L1 and L2 both make about ambiguity.

params.name: daysToDiscovery
params.label: Days until the gap is discovered

items.compute: const multiplier = 1 + Math.pow(params.daysToDiscovery / 5, 1.5); return { costMultiplier: Math.round(multiplier * 10) / 10 };

outputs.label: Relative cost to fix (x the original conversation)
